name: Atharva
summary: A 2022 mythological-fantasy graphic novel hero fronted by cricketer MS Dhoni. It combines a warrior's revenge quest with Indian myth and an augmented-reality app.
origin: Atharva: The Origin was written by debut author Ramesh Thamilmani and produced by Virzu Studios with MIDAS Deals. MS Dhoni stars as the title hero, whom he called India's first mythological superhero with a contemporary twist. An earlier 2015 plan had Shah Rukh Khan in the role. A hardcover appeared in 2022 with an AR app, and Pratilipi Comics later relaunched it as a vertical-scroll comic.
powers: Battles demon-like creatures in the first-look clip

The hardcover was pre-sold on Amazon.in at Rs 1,499, with an AR app that shows 3D models of characters.
Producer Sakshi Singh Dhoni said the story suits a web series better than a film.
Virzu Studios first announced the book in January 2015 with Shah Rukh Khan as Atharva, years before Dhoni was attached.
Some think Atharva is a Vedic or ancient epic figure.

facts.text: Buyers got an AR app: scanning the pages shows 3D models of the characters and opens short games set in Atharva's world. The launch team called it the first novel in India with augmented reality.
Atharva was first announced in January 2015, years before Dhoni, with Shah Rukh Khan named as the title hero and a teaser posted on YouTube in the first week of that month.
The 2015 plan was a different tale: a young king chasing his destiny on a mythical island in a forgotten past, full of fantastical birds, beasts and monsters.

To get the fights right, the team hired stuntmen to act out the action, then drew from that, and built 3D models of the characters. The author said it felt more like film pre-production than comic-making.
Rajinikanth was once considered for the lead, but the team dropped the idea because he was making the animated film Kochadaiiyaan at the time and they wanted to avoid something similar.
To merge Dhoni's face into the artwork, the team photographed many of his expressions. Asked to look calm while striking a blow, Dhoni joked that nobody stays calm while hitting someone.

A 2020 statement described the book as the tale of an Aghori held at a high-tech facility. The published synopsis instead has a revenge-seeking warrior on a young Earth, and the 2015 plan a young king: three pitches, one title.
Atharva was promised for mid-2015, yet it only reached readers in spring 2022, a wait of roughly seven years after the January 2015 announcement.
Wikipedia lists the book at 150 pages and says it was touted as India's first three-dimensional graphic novel, with a realistic visual take on about 150 scenes.
Thamilmani co-founded Virzu Studios in 2013 with Vel Mohan while running BLD Design Studios. Atharva was the studio's debut project, meant to blend storytelling with computer graphics.
The 2015 version was illustrated by Ramesh Archarya, and its text was to be paired with full-page 3D pictures at key moments of the plot.
IANS reported that the team spent several years building the world, and that every character and piece of artwork, Dhoni's included, followed extensive research.
In October 2022 Thamilmani was named director of the first Tamil film from Dhoni Entertainment, a family entertainer whose concept came from Sakshi Dhoni herself.
Dhoni was not keen at first, but liked the artwork when he saw it and agreed to take part, then stayed flexible and involved throughout the photo shoot.
Pratilipi's creative head said the redrawn comic was meant to enthrall a bigger audience and bring more kids to reading comics; its product head called high fantasy young but in demand in India.
IndiaGlitz reported Atharva as the first fantasy title in a planned book series, announced when Dhoni posted the minute-long motion poster on his own Facebook page.
The Quint's report described the first-look clip as an animated Dhoni fighting a demon-like army, and billed the project as a mythological web series backed by Dhoni Entertainment.
DT Next framed the book as an effort to give Indian children a superhero to look up to, with realistic images in the manner of Batman or Superman.
Thamilmani said the scale was big enough to want a big name, and that Dhoni gave more than his face: he collaborated heavily and contributed far beyond what the team expected.
Pratilipi Comics, founded in 2020, carries titles from houses such as Amar Chitra Katha, Campfire and Diamond Comics, so the Atharva redraw sits beside well-known Indian comic publishers.

kidSummary: Atharva is a warrior in a faraway, forgotten time when Earth was very young. He sets out to take revenge, meets strange creatures on the way, and ends up learning big secrets about life and about himself.

story.title: A very young Earth
story.text: The story begins in a long-forgotten era when the world is still young and wild.

story.title: A warrior's quest
story.text: Atharva, an experienced warrior, sets out on a long journey because he wants revenge.

story.title: Strange creatures
story.text: On the road he crosses magnificent lands and meets strange creatures he has never seen before.

story.title: Finding himself
story.text: The trip changes him: instead of only chasing revenge, he learns life's secrets and discovers who he really is.
